findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in list
findings.body: The refactor dropped `key={key}` when GrafanaRuleLoader was replaced with GrafanaRuleListItem. Without a key, React reconciles these list items by index. As rules are appended or reordered, component state such as open menus, drawers and modals can attach to the wrong rule. React will also emit key warnings.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens in list view
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule`; `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined. AlertRuleMenu still shows 'Silence notifications' because canSilence is computed from promRule abilities. However, the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. Clicking Silence therefore does nothing.

findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items silently disappear without rulerRule
findings.body: canPause and canDelete now come from promRule abilities, but rendering still requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` for Pause and `rulerRule` for Delete (line 165). In the list view no rulerRule is passed, so users with permission lose Pause and Delete entirely. The new test even asserts that only 4 menu items appear, which encodes this regression.

findings.title: ModifyExport not supported for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: `isAlertingRule` is used as the 'supported' flag for ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently. The ruler version uses isGrafanaManagedAlertRule, which is true for any Grafana rule, including recording rules. With this change, Grafana recording rules lose export, pause and restore capabilities in the list view.

findings.title: returnTo dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The previous implementation built the view href with `{ returnTo: createReturnTo() }`. The new link omits it, so navigating back from the rule detail page no longer returns the user to the filtered list state.
